summaries.Romania: Romania faces a political crisis with Siegfried Mureșan designated as premier but lacking clear parliamentary support, while the country risks a credit downgrade if political instability persists. Key economic and infrastructure projects continue despite government uncertainty.
summaries.Healthcare: AI is transforming healthcare delivery through clinical decision support and chronic care management, though regulators and providers express concerns about safety, bias, and implementation without proper oversight. Kennedy's health leadership is reshaping preventive services policy and vaccine discussions.
summaries.Tech: Apple released iOS 27 with advanced Siri AI and new hardware (iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12), while broader tech focuses on AI safety concerns, with OpenAI disclosing model misalignment incidents and Microsoft revealing internal criticism of data scraping practices. Geothermal and robotaxi companies are raising massive funding rounds amid AI infrastructure demand.

items.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
